primaryChecks.text: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

primaryChecks.text: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に割当名が直接現れ、前後の文脈を照合した。

primaryChecks.text: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.
primaryChecks.previousContext: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に割当名が直接現れ、前後の文脈を照合した。

primaryChecks.text: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文に割当名が直接現れ、前後の文脈を照合した。
